# We are 'Marching' on 🚶‍♀️🚶‍♀️


### Bye bye February


[HeyFood](https://substack.com/@heyfood)


Mar 10, 2022


We honestly think February deserves the award ‘‘


*Best month of the year’’*


Here are some reasons why


1.


We launched our Gift ordering feature, You can now send food gifts to loved ones without them knowing. Like the idea? Check it out


[here.](http://heyfood.africa/download)


1.


The F in February stood for Free delivery; Free food; Free vouchers; which you probably didn’t know about because you don’t follow us on Twitter or


[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/CZjn7skIEUD/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link) .


Better click the picture and follow us now make we ‘gbe e trabaye’.


1.


These past two weeks were particularly hard for the whole world, take a break; have a laugh; read our


[blog post](https://heyfood.medium.com/food-over-flowers-or-petty-gifts-ff58fd454659) on valentine's. Note: There was no love contained in this write-up.


Text within this block will maintain its original spacing when published


```text
HAPPY INTERNATIONAL WOMEN'S DAY 👸👸
```


To all the women around the world, you’re the motivation that keeps us going.


Motivation from the sauce 🔥🔥
